verdict.rationale: Pulley is an equity-management SaaS. The evidence covers cap tables, SAFEs, 409A valuations, liquidity programs and a term-sheet scanner, but never mentions an MCP client capability or any way to connect external MCP servers. A SaaS product with AI features could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
